title: Sony BRAVIA 4K VH1 (device BRAVIA_VH1, KD-55XH9096, MediaTek MT5895 / MT5835), EU firmware
header:
Sony BRAVIA 4K VH1 (device BRAVIA_VH1, KD-55XH9096, MediaTek MT5895 / MT5835), EU firmware
Google TV 12 (API 31), build BRAVIA_VH1_EU-user 12 STT2.230505.001.S137 626241
Product codename Valhalla_EU; ro.boot.product.hardware.sku = KD-55XH9096

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh1/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh1/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher on this set: com.google.android.tvlauncher (leanback). Pass it to restore.sh as above.
Live TV / tuner app: com.sony.dtv.tvx (set it as live_tv_package in the launcher's config.xml and hide it).
Keep the com.sony.dtv.tvinput.* services, com.sony.dtv.braviasync*, com.sony.dtv.tvapi,
com.sony.dtv.sonysystemservice, imeproxy, settingsprovider, systemupdate/update (firmware), the Sony
settings apps and all com.mediatek.*: they drive HDMI, the tuner, Bravia Sync, updates and the remote.
Chromecast built-in (mediashell) and firmware updates kept.

setupwraith is still enabled on this unit: Home already resolves to CleanYourTV. Disable
com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith if the Google TV setup wizard retakes Home after a reboot.
Closest sibling list: examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh2/ (VH2 / KD-55X80J).
Same Android platform (BRAVIA_VH1) as the PA-firmware notes in
docs/devices/sony-kd-55x9000h.md (retail KD-55X9000H); this list is the EU build.

Lived with for weeks on a KD-55XH9096 (Spain/EU) with CleanYourTV; Live TV, HDMI Inputs, Ethernet
and Chromecast still work. If something breaks, re-enable it with `pm enable <package>` and please report it.

apps.note: Samba TV fingerprints what's on screen
